patterns: APPSC asks BrahMos as a one-liner: name origin (Brahmaputra + Moskva) and partner country (Russia).
Mission Shakti asked as an APPSC G1 statement set: DRDO-ISRO, India fourth ASAT nation; trap 'done in upper atmosphere so no debris' is false.
Function-identification items: anti-radiation missile destroys enemy radars (Rudram); Astra = BVR air-to-air; Barak = Israel.
Other PSCs test Shaurya/Nirbhay/Astra type and range with 'not correct' statements; Shaurya range figures in PYQs (600-750 km) differ from newer notes (700-1,900 km).
App MCQs are heavily multi-statement and current-affairs-laden (2025-26 tests, exports, Sudarshan Chakra, Project Kusha) - much denser than APPSC's direct partner/name/function questions.
